avertissement: Each rule cites its official text. The summary and the scope (codes, countries) are written by AI from that text and are not reviewed by a lawyer: they are leads to check, not advice.

regles.titre: Responsible economic operator in the EU
regles.resume: A consumer product can be placed on the EU market only if an economic operator established in the Union is responsible for it, with its contact details on the product, the packaging or an accompanying document. Marketplaces have their own control obligations.

effet.question: Is an economic operator established in the EU responsible for this product, with its contact details on the product or the packaging?
effet.si_oui: Responsible operator in the EU designated
effet.si_non_texte: No responsible operator in the EU: the product cannot be placed on the market

regles.resume: Earbuds, headphones, phones and the other listed devices sold in the EU must charge through a USB-C port and carry a pictogram showing whether a charger is supplied.

source.nom: Directive (EU) 2022/2380, known as the "common charger" directive

effet.question: Does the product charge through a USB-C port, with the "charger included or not" pictogram?
effet.si_non_texte: Without a USB-C port, sale prohibited in the EU

regles.resume: A toy placed on the EU market bears the CE marking and comes with an EU declaration of conformity drawn up by the manufacturer.

source.nom: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys

effet.question: Does the toy bear the CE marking, with an EU declaration of conformity on file?
effet.si_oui: CE marking and declaration of conformity on file
effet.si_non_texte: Without CE marking, the toy cannot be sold in the EU

regles.resume: Since 1 July 2026, a flat customs duty of €3 applies to each distinct item in a shipment worth less than €150 entering the EU, until the permanent regime takes effect.

source.nom: Council of the EU, agreement of 12 December 2025

regles.titre: End of the de minimis exemption in the United States
regles.resume: Since 29 August 2025, shipments of 800 USD or less are no longer exempt: duties are due from the first dollar, whatever the country of origin.

effet.texte: No exemption: duties due on every shipment

regles.resume: The importer of a children's product certifies in writing that it complies with the applicable safety rules, based on testing by a third-party laboratory accepted by the CPSC.

source.nom: Consumer Product Safety Act, section 14 ; 16 CFR part 1110

effet.question: Is a CPC based on testing by a CPSC-accepted laboratory available?
effet.si_non_texte: Without a CPC, CBP can refuse the import

regles.resume: A device that emits radio waves (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi) must have an FCC equipment authorization before it is imported or marketed in the United States.

effet.question: Does the device have an FCC identifier (FCC ID) or a supplier's declaration of conformity?

regles.resume: Since 1 February 2019, lithium-ion power banks fall within the scope of the Japanese law on the safety of electrical appliances: manufacture, import and sale are prohibited without technical conformity and PSE marking. AC adapters are also covered.

source.nom: Electrical Appliance and Material Safety Act (METI)

effet.question: Does the product bear the PSE marking, with an importer declared to METI?
effet.si_non_texte: Without PSE marking, import and sale prohibited in Japan

regles.titre: Australian GST on low value goods
regles.resume: For goods with a customs value of 1,000 AUD or less sold to an Australian consumer, the 10% GST is collected at the point of sale by the seller or by the marketplace.

source.ref: GST on low value imported goods

effet.texte: 10% GST to collect at the point of sale (value ≤ 1,000 AUD)

regles.resume: Since 22 June 2022, a consumer product containing button or coin batteries must have a secure compartment and must have passed the tests set by the mandatory standard.

source.nom: Consumer Goods (Products Containing Button/Coin Batteries) Safety Standard

effet.question: No button batteries, or a secure compartment and testing to the Australian standard: is that the case?
effet.si_oui: Button batteries: compliant or not concerned
effet.si_non_texte: Unsecured button batteries: sale prohibited in Australia

regles.titre: Lithium-ion batteries shipped alone by air
regles.resume: Lithium-ion batteries shipped alone (UN 3480) are forbidden in the hold of passenger aircraft: cargo aircraft only, state of charge of 30% at most, prescribed packaging and labelling.

effet.question: Does the shipment go by cargo aircraft, or by land or sea, with the battery charged to 30% at most and labelled UN 3480?

simulations.titre: 30-point increase in duties on Chinese electronics
simulations.resume: Fictional announcement: at midnight, Washington time, +30 points of duty on chargers, batteries, communication devices and earbuds originating in China. Goods loaded before the measure takes effect stay at the current rate.

simulations.titre: Suspension of lithium batteries in Australia
simulations.resume: Fictional announcement: Australia suspends with immediate effect the import of lithium-ion batteries sold online, for the duration of a safety recall.
